title: Observability: KEY_IMPORT and KEY_GENERATE fips_gate log omits provider name
description: The fips_gate failure log at KEY_IMPORT (line 1787) logs only the algo name and wolfCrypt error code: 'KEY_IMPORT(algo): FIPS not operational (N)'. The provider name (actual_provider) is known at that point but is absent from the message. Same for KEY_GENERATE (line 2181). By contrast, the ioctl_init fips_gate failure (line 778) correctly logs provider name. A support engineer handed a ring buffer snippet cannot tell which provider's gate failed — critical when multiple FIPS providers are registered for the same algo name.
